content.general_rule: The District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission shall not admit a complaint unless it is filed within two years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen.
content.exception: shall not admit a complaint unless it is filed within two years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen
conditions: it is filed within two years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen
